title: CommitLoreBench run record
description: One line of bench/results/*.jsonl. One line = one (task, condition, seed) run.

run_id.description: Identifies the runner invocation. Every row of one invocation shares it.

cond.description: Condition arm. v0.1: commitlore-on | commitlore-off. M4 adds the ablation arms.

seed.description: Seed fixing the workspace commit dates and the dry-run driver's PRNG.

reproposed.description: detect.reproposed_if matched the agent's transcript, diff or commits.

violations.description: Number of detect.violation_if clauses that matched.

stopped_by.description: How the run ended, distinguishing an enforced stop from an observed overrun. completed=finished within every budget. timeout=wall clock elapsed and the harness killed the process. over-turns=finished on its own having exceeded the turn budget (the claude CLI has no --max-turns, so the budget is observed, not applied). over-tokens=global token cap exhausted; with turns=0 and tokens=0 the run never started. error=driver or setup failure, so the row carries no usable measurement.

simulated.description: True when the driver fabricated the transcript. Simulated rows are never evidence.

matched.description: Labels of the detector clauses that fired, for auditing a judgement.

error.description: Failure detail, or why a run was skipped.
